exposure: dehiscence of the caesarean section scar
cohort: A single patient who presented with intermittent lower abdominal pain and occasional passage of small clots, leading to a diagnosis of secondary postpartum haemorrhage due to retained products of conception.
finding: This case report highlights that retained products of conception can cause secondary postpartum haemorrhage, emphasizing the importance of thorough history taking and clinical examination even when patients initially dismiss symptoms as normal postpartum experiences.
mod_finding: Dehiscence of the caesarean section scar is mentioned as one of the rarer causes of secondary PPH, though the specific case presented does not attribute PPH to the mode of birth.
